# Rivetory Agent Desk

> Rivetory is an after-hours agent desk for water and fire restoration companies. It answers missed calls, books the job and texts the owner. Never lose a job to a missed call.

- Demo line: (208) 510-0776

## Offer

Free 14-day pilot, set up for the customer in 30 minutes. Then Core $297 per month or Pro $497 per month, month to month, cancel any time. Guarantee: if the desk does not capture at least one job worth more than the monthly fee in the first 30 paid days, the next month is free.

## The desk

The desk answers after-hours and overflow calls forwarded from a company's main line. It recognizes two kinds of caller: a person, and an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer. It takes the job details, books the visit or alerts the on-call tech for an emergency, and sends the owner a summary by text and email within a minute. Every call is recorded and the desk says it is an automated assistant at the start of every call.
